method: Sum per100g nutrient*edible ingredient grams/100, divide batch by4. US total carb minus dietary fiber for net carbs. No sugar alcohol subtraction. No cooking-yield scaling of raw meat. All specified oil, acid, sauces, seeds, yeast and salad included. Black pepper to taste and salt excluded from five macros; sodium not reported. Values are estimates, not lab results.
